modules.name: Society Manager Permissions
modules.description: Permission-based assignment of Society Manager work to committee members by Raghuvir Admin.

modules.name: Owners and Tenants
modules.description: Registration of residents as owner or tenant, flat occupancy status, and tenant agreement tracking.

requirements.title: Assign permissions to committee members
requirements.description: Raghuvir Admin can give each committee member (President, Secretary or any other member) one or more permissions from the defined list.

requirements.title: Support the eight defined permissions
requirements.description: Permissions are Approve residents, Check complaints, Assign society complaints, Manage documents, Approve bookings, Post notices, Manage watchmen and View family data, each allowing the actions listed in the document.

requirements.title: Mark each flat as owner-living, tenant-living or vacant
requirements.description: Every flat carries one of three statuses: owner-living, tenant-living or vacant.

requirements.title: Resident registers as Owner or Tenant
requirements.description: A resident chooses to register as either Owner or Tenant.

requirements.title: Capture owner name and rent agreement end date for tenants
requirements.description: A tenant also gives the owner's name and the rent agreement end date.

requirements.title: Send rent agreement end reminder
requirements.description: 15 days before the agreement end date, the tenant and the Society Manager get a reminder.

rules.title: Society Manager work is given by permission, not title
rules.description: What a Society Manager can do depends on the permissions granted, not on their title.

rules.title: Keep at least one holder of key permissions per project
rules.description: Every project must keep at least one person with Approve residents and at least one with Check complaints. The system blocks removing the last one.

rules.title: One main user per flat
rules.description: Each flat has one main user, the person who lives there (owner or tenant).

rules.title: Tenant access ends only after Society Manager confirms
rules.description: Tenant access does not end automatically at the agreement end date; it ends only after a Society Manager confirms.
